---
name: forge-security
description: "Use when reviewing account roles, server actions, learner privacy, AI eligibility, teaching uploads or database migrations."
---
Trace authentication to authorization and privileged database access. Test trusted app_metadata roles, owner isolation, direct-action tampering, revoked rights, private drafts, answer keys and report permissions. Service-role access requires explicit server checks; UI visibility is not authorization.
Verify 13+ signup/profile rules and external-AI denial for minors/unknown ages; adults require administrator approval. Preserve free-only, zero-price validation, data_collection deny and ZDR. Minimize provider payloads; never persist coach history or expose credentials.
Inspect upload signatures, bounded extraction, archive expansion, parser safety and retention. Verify migrations deny client access and permit required application operations. Distinguish configured safeguards from verified encryption, retention, consent and legal eligibility. Return evidence-ranked findings and concrete tests; never claim regulatory certification.
